[hbonds\.py L25](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/hbonds.py#L25) uses [hbonds\.py L4](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/hbonds.py#L4) to explicitly add hydrogen atoms to an [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20), while [hbonds\.py L142](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/hbonds.py#L142) identifies hydrogen bonds and annotates [hbonds\.py L219](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/hbonds.py#L219) and [hbonds\.py L219](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/hbonds.py#L219)\. An alternative approach using the external HBPLUS program is provided by [hbonds\_hbplus\.py L177](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/hbonds_hbplus.py#L177), which converts [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20) data to PDB format for HBPLUS processing and then parses its output for annotation\.

 **Chirality and D\-Amino Acid Handling**

 To support diverse molecular design, the framework can handle D\-amino acids\. [`models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/ncaa_transforms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/ncaa_transforms.py) in [`models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms) provides [ncaa\_transforms\.py L41](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/ncaa_transforms.py#L41), which conditionally mirrors protein and ligand components of an [engine\.py L92](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/engine.py#L92) about the Z\-axis, effectively converting L\-amino acids to D\-amino acids\. This is complemented by [ncaa\_transforms\.py L109](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/ncaa_transforms.py#L109), which annotates the [engine\.py L92](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/engine.py#L92) with [ncaa\_transforms\.py L120](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/ncaa_transforms.py#L120) flags\.

 **Cropping and Sampling**

 For targeted design, RFdiffusion3 includes specialized cropping and sampling transformations\. [`models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/dna_crop.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/dna_crop.py) contains [dna\_crop\.py L198](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/dna_crop.py#L198), a [README\.md?plain=1 L453](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rf3/README.md?plain=1#L453) for isolating and expanding protein\-DNA contact regions, ensuring the integrity of DNA base\-paired residues\. For protein\-protein interfaces, [`models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/ppi_transforms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/ppi_transforms.py) offers [ppi\_transforms\.py L307](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/ppi_transforms.py#L307), which performs spatial cropping around an interface while ensuring the entire binder chain is retained\. [ppi\_transforms\.py L240](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/ppi_transforms.py#L240) computes and samples a fraction of ground\-truth hotspot atoms\.

 **Symmetry and Virtual Atoms**

 Symmetry operations are handled by [`models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/symmetry.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/symmetry.py) in [`models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms), with [symmetry\.py L10](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/symmetry.py#L10) adding features like [symmetry\.py L22](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/symmetry.py#L22) and [symmetry\.py L24](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/symmetry.py#L24) along with symmetry transformation matrices\. Virtual atoms, used for padding and standardization, are managed by [`models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/virtual_atoms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/virtual_atoms.py) through [virtual\_atoms\.py L139](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/virtual_atoms.py#L139), which ensures a fixed number of atoms per token\. The processes of generating and manipulating symmetric atom arrays and symmetry frames are further detailed in [RFdiffusion3: Inference Engine and Input Specification](https://codewiki.google/github.com/rosettacommons/foundry#de-novo-biomolecular-interaction-design-rfdiffusion3-rfdiffusion3-inference-engine-and-input-specification)\.

 **Diffusion and Augmentation**

 Transformations also include mechanisms for diffusion and data augmentation\. [design\_transforms\.py L531](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/design_transforms.py#L531) in [`models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/design_transforms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/design_transforms.py) applies random rigid body perturbations to the motif's center of mass during training, enhancing robustness\. [design\_transforms\.py L611](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/design_transforms.py#L611) further modifies coordinate noise, for example, by zeroing noise for fixed motif atoms and introducing time\-dependent center\-of\-mass perturbations\.

 **Pipeline Construction**

 The construction of these complex data processing pipelines is orchestrated by functions within [`models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/pipelines.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/pipelines.py), such as [pipelines\.py L311](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/pipelines.py#L311)\. These functions dynamically integrate various transformations based on whether the process is for inference or training, the specified conditions, and other configuration parameters\. This modular approach allows for flexible and efficient data preparation tailored to specific design tasks\.### RFdiffusion3: Practical Applications and Tutorials

| Parameter | Purpose | Enzyme Design | Nucleic Acid Binder Design | Protein Binder Design | Small Molecule Binder Design | Symmetry\-Constrained Designs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| contig | Defines designed and fixed regions, chain breaks, and length ranges\. | Fixed catalytic residues, designed scaffold\. | Fixed nucleic acid, designed protein\. | Fixed target protein, designed binder\. | Designed protein scaffold, fixed small molecule\. | Fixed motifs \(symmetric or unsymmetric\), designed symmetric scaffold\. |
| symmetry | Configures symmetric design \(e\.g\., C3, D2\)\. | Not typically used unless the enzyme itself is symmetric\. | Not typically used unless the binder/target complex is symmetric\. | Not typically used unless the binder/target complex is symmetric\. | Not typically used unless the binder/target complex is symmetric\. | ⭐ Critical for defining symmetry type and motif handling\. |
| ligand | Specifies non\-protein molecules to be treated as part of the motif\. | Required for catalytic cofactors/substrates\. | Used for nucleic acids \(though often in contig as well\)\. | Not typically used\. | Required for the small molecule to be bound\. | Can include specific ligands within symmetric motifs\. |
| select\_fixed\_atoms | Fixes atomic coordinates for specific atoms/residues\. | Crucial for catalytic residues, active site geometry\. | Fixes specific atoms on nucleic acids for precise interactions\. | Can fix parts of the target protein to maintain conformation\. | Fixes specific atoms on the small molecule for precise binding interactions\. | Fixes atoms within symmetric motifs to maintain relative positions\. |
| ori\_token | Controls the center of mass for the designed region\. | Defines the origin for the designed enzyme scaffold relative to the active site\. | Places the designed binder's COM relative to the nucleic acid\. | Can infer from hotspots or be explicitly set\. | Places the designed binder's COM relative to the small molecule\. | Places the designed symmetric complex's COM relative to the symmetric center\. |
| select\_hotspots | Identifies key interaction sites to guide binder proximity\. | Not directly used, select\_fixed\_atoms and unindex serve similar purpose for active site\. | Can specify residues/atoms on nucleic acid to interact with binder\. | Essential for defining target binding sites\. | Can specify atoms on the small molecule for strong interactions\. | Not typically used\. |
| select\_exposed | Specifies atoms that should be solvent\-exposed in the final design\. | Can expose parts of a ligand or residue\. | Can expose parts of nucleic acids or surrounding protein\. | Can expose specific target residues\. | Can be used to expose parts of the small molecule\. | Not typically used\. |
| select\_buried | Specifies atoms that should be buried within the designed structure\. | Can bury parts of a ligand or residue\. | Can bury parts of nucleic acids or surrounding protein for stability\. | Can bury specific target residues for stability\. | Can be used to bury parts of the small molecule\. | Not typically used\. |
| Other Parameters | unindex: Specifies residues whose sequence placement is not predefined\. is\_non\_loopy: Biases towards less looped structures\. redesign\_motif\_sidechains: Allows sidechain redesign for motifs\. | unindex critical for catalytic residues\. is\_non\_loopy for structured scaffolds\. | unindex for flexible motif placement\. is\_non\_loopy for structured binders\. hbond\_donor/acceptor for specific interactions\. | is\_non\_loopy recommended for structured binders\. infer\_ori\_strategy often hotspots\. | hbond\_donor/acceptor for specific interactions\. is\_non\_loopy for structured binders\. | id and is\_unsym\_motif are specific to symmetry config\. low\_memory\_mode for resource management\. |

The RFdiffusion3 documentation and example set guides users through practical applications of the model for various protein design tasks, detailing input preparation, configuration, execution, and output analysis\. The core documentation, located in the [`models/rfd3/docs`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs) directory, explains how to control inference calculations through YAML or JSON files, specifying settings such as [input\_parsing\.py L134](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L134) and [input\_parsing\.py L185](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L185), alongside command\-line configuration options like [all\.ipynb L102](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L102) and [all\.ipynb L103](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L103)\. It further elaborates on input parameters using [input\.md?plain=1 L112](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L112) fields for defining constraints such as [input\_parsing\.py L142](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L142) and [input\_parsing\.py L152](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L152), and introduces the [parsing\.py L26](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/parsing.py#L26) mini\-language for atom/residue selections and [input\.md?plain=1 L187](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L187) for defining protein regions\. The documentation also addresses the trade\-off between designability and diversity, explaining how to adjust parameters like [input\.md?plain=1 L69](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L69) and [designability\_vs\_diversity\.md?plain=1 L8](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/designability_vs_diversity.md?plain=1#L8) to balance these factors\.

 The [`models/rfd3/docs/examples`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/examples) directory provides configuration files and scripts demonstrating RFdiffusion3 usage across different design scenarios\. These examples cover enzyme design, nucleic acid binder design, protein binder design, small molecule binder design, and protein design with symmetry constraints\. For instance, enzyme design examples detail parameters for input PDB, ligand specification, and fixed atom selections, while nucleic acid binder design outlines configurations for various nucleic acid types with parameters like [input\_parsing\.py L134](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L134), [input\_parsing\.py L187](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L187), and hydrogen bond conditioning using external tools like [README\.md?plain=1 L143](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/README.md?plain=1#L143)\. Protein binder design focuses on protein\-protein interaction \(PPI\) designs, recommending specific settings for [input\_parsing\.py L188](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L188) and [input\_parsing\.py L176](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L176)\. Similarly, small molecule binder design shows how to define [input\_parsing\.py L142](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L142) and specify [input\_parsing\.py L172](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L172) or [input\_parsing\.py L170](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L170) atoms\. Symmetry\-constrained designs illustrate how to configure symmetry groups such as [README\.md?plain=1 L61](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rf3/README.md?plain=1#L61) and [README\.md?plain=1 L392](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rf3/README.md?plain=1#L392) with [symmetry\_utils\.py L50](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/symmetry/symmetry_utils.py#L50) and [symmetry\_utils\.py L55](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/symmetry/symmetry_utils.py#L55) parameters\. A common shell script, [`models/rfd3/docs/examples/run_inf_tutorial.sh`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/examples/run_inf_tutorial.sh), demonstrates batch execution of these inference examples\.

 The [`models/rfd3/docs/tutorials`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/tutorials) directory offers comprehensive, step\-by\-step guides, beginning with installation and verification on Unix\-based systems\. It covers environment management using conda, package installation via pip, and downloading model checkpoints using [README\.md?plain=1 L1](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L1), with support for custom storage locations via the [README\.md?plain=1 L46](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L46) flag\. GPU acceleration and integration with high\-performance computing \(HPC\) systems like SLURM are also detailed\. Specific tutorials guide users through protein and small molecule binder design, including PDB cleaning, configuring YAML or JSON files with parameters like [input\_parsing\.py L134](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L134) and [input\_parsing\.py L176](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L176), executing [README\.md?plain=1 L1](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L1), and analyzing output files\. The [`models/rfd3/docs/tutorials/binder_design_tutorial_files`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/tutorials/binder_design_tutorial_files) subdirectory contains example [pdl1\.sh L2](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/tutorials/binder_design_tutorial_files/PDL1/pdl1.sh#L2) scripts for running these designs on Slurm clusters, configuring resources such as GPU, CPU, memory, and time\. Further tutorials address nucleic acid binder design, outlining JSON configurations with parameters for fixed and designed regions, and protein\-protein interface design, emphasizing specific input PDBs and [input\.md?plain=1 L187](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L187) definitions\. Enzyme design tutorials range from basic design around a ligand to advanced scaffolding around a fixed catalytic motif, detailing JSON configurations, execution, and output analysis for metrics like [trainer\_utils\.py L464](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/trainer/trainer_utils.py#L464) and [design\_metrics\.py L44](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/metrics/design_metrics.py#L44)\.## De Novo Multi\-Polymer Interaction Design \(RFdiffusion3NA\)

```
{
  "multi_polymer_design": {
    "contig": "10-10,20-20R,30-30D", // Protein (10), RNA (20), and DNA (30) chains
    "length": "60-60", // Total length constraint
    "input": "path/to/my/input.pdb", // Input PDB/CIF, optional depending on constraints
    "select_unfixed_sequence": "1-10", // Unfix sequence for the first 10 residues (protein)
    "redesign_motif_sidechains": true // Redesign sidechains for any input motifs
  }
}
```

[README\.md?plain=1 L81](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L81) extends [README\.md?plain=1 L71](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L71) to facilitate the *de novo* design of multi\-polymer structures, specifically protein\-DNA\-RNA complexes, incorporating atomic functional sites\. This system offers both training and inference capabilities, enabling the creation of complex biomolecular interactions with precise constraint conditioning and customization\. Practical design tasks are supported through a collection of tutorials\.

 Installation of the model is achieved via [README\.md?plain=1 L134](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/README.md?plain=1#L134)\. Checkpoints are managed and downloaded using the [README\.md?plain=1 L1](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L1) command, which automatically configures the [\.env L63](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/.env#L63) environment variable for locating pre\-trained models\.

 The primary mechanism for initiating design tasks is the [README\.md?plain=1 L1](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L1) command\. This command orchestrates the inference workflow, processing input specifications that define design constraints and parameters, typically provided in JSON or YAML format\. A key capability is the specification of multi\-polymer contigs, allowing users to designate RNA \([README\.md?plain=1 L161](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L161)\) or DNA \([README\.md?plain=1 L392](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rf3/README.md?plain=1#L392)\) suffixes within contig parts \(e\.g\., [README\.md?plain=1 L55](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/README.md?plain=1#L55)\) to define heterogeneous polymer chains in the design\. The inference engine supports various advanced conditioning options, such as fixing sequences, unfixing sequences for inverse folding analogous to MPNN, or selectively unfixing sidechains, thereby enabling diverse design strategies\. Hydrogen bond conditioning is also integrated, requiring manual installation and configuration of [README\.md?plain=1 L143](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/README.md?plain=1#L143)\. For further details on these inference mechanisms, refer to [RFdiffusion3NA: Advanced Input Specification and Inference Workflow](https://codewiki.google/github.com/rosettacommons/foundry#rfdiffusion3na-advanced-input-specification-and-inference-workflow)\.

 For model training and fine\-tuning, [README\.md?plain=1 L81](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L81) provides a comprehensive framework compatible with AtomWorks datasets\. The training process can be configured to utilize PDB and CCD mirrors by adjusting [all\.ipynb L183](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L183) and environment variables\. Training runs are initiated via the script located at [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/train.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/train.py)\. The system leverages Lightning Fabric for distributed data parallel \(DDP\) training, managing [engine\.py L78](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/engine.py#L78) and [engine\.py L77](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/engine.py#L77)\. Training incorporates dynamic conditioning through the generation of randomized "problems" with varying conditioning tasks, defined within configuration files in [`models/rfd3na/configs`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/configs)\. Additional information on the training process is available in [RFdiffusion3NA: Training Framework and Evaluation Metrics for Multi\-Polymers](https://codewiki.google/github.com/rosettacommons/foundry#rfdiffusion3na-training-framework-and-evaluation-metrics-for-multi-polymers)\.

 The [README\.md?plain=1 L81](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L81) framework is built with a modular configuration approach, employing Hydra to apply overrides to base configurations, which are defined in experiment configuration files within [`models/rfd3na/configs`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/configs)\. The system also provides a suite of utilities located in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/utils`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/utils) for preparing [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20) objects, performing I/O operations, and visualizing structures with PyMOL\. These utilities facilitate the manipulation and analysis of biomolecular structures throughout the design process\.

 Practical applications of [README\.md?plain=1 L81](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L81) are illustrated through a series of tutorials found in [`models/rfd3na/docs/tutorials`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/docs/tutorials)\. These tutorials demonstrate various design tasks, including enzyme design, nucleic acid binder design, and protein\-protein interface design\. Each tutorial offers step\-by\-step guidance on setting up configurations, executing the design process, and analyzing the resulting outputs\. These practical guides are available in [RFdiffusion3NA: Practical Design Tutorials and Examples](https://codewiki.google/github.com/rosettacommons/foundry#rfdiffusion3na-practical-design-tutorials-and-examples)\.### RFdiffusion3NA: Model Architecture and Diffusion Process

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

RFdiffusion3NA's core architecture for multi\-polymer design is built around an expanded diffusion module, which is responsible for denoising atom coordinates and predicting sequence information across proteins, DNA, and RNA\. The model's operations are orchestrated by a token initialization process and an inference sampler, enabling conditional generation and classifier\-free guidance\.

 The primary model, represented by the [RFD3\.py L19](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/RFD3.py#L19) class in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/model/RFD3.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/model/RFD3.py), functions as a high\-level wrapper\. It integrates a [encoders\.py L36](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/encoders.py#L36), a [RF3\.py L71](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rf3/src/rf3/model/RF3.py#L71), and an [engine\.py L54](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/engine.py#L54)\. During training, the [RFD3\.py L19](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/RFD3.py#L19) model performs a single denoising step via the [RF3\.py L71](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rf3/src/rf3/model/RF3.py#L71), while inference involves a full diffusion rollout managed by the [engine\.py L54](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/engine.py#L54)\. This setup supports classifier\-free guidance, where reference features are prepared by selectively masking or removing conditional information\.

 The central denoising architecture is implemented in the [RFD3\_diffusion\_module\.py L32](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/RFD3_diffusion_module.py#L32) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/model/RFD3_diffusion_module.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/model/RFD3_diffusion_module.py)\. This module employs a UNet\-like structure to predict denoised atomic positions and sequence logits\. Key components include Fourier embeddings for time steps, linear embeddings with pooling for atom\-to\-sequence aggregation, local atom transformers for encoding, diffusion token encoders for token processing, local token transformers for diffusion, and compact streaming decoders for decoding\. It also supports a recycling mechanism to refine predictions over multiple passes and optimizes memory for large structures\.

 Classifier\-free guidance is facilitated by utilities in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/model/cfg_utils.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/model/cfg_utils.py), which modify conditioning features to enable selective removal or masking of motif\-related information during generation\. The diffusion sampling is managed by the [inference\_sampler\.py L572](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/inference_sampler.py#L572) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/model/inference_sampler.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/model/inference_sampler.py)\. This sampler can dispatch to either general diffusion sampling with motif alignment or symmetry\-aware diffusion\. The core diffusion loop involves noise scheduling, initial structure generation, iterative denoising, and coordinate updates, including mechanisms for classifier\-free guidance and motif fixing\.

 The neural network layers essential for this architecture are located in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/model/layers`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/model/layers)\. These layers include attention mechanisms with pairwise biases, such as [attention\.py L91](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/attention.py#L91) and [attention\.py L188](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/attention.py#L188), which are optimized for local and sparse attention\. Block utilities within this directory provide helper functions for data manipulation, such as [block\_utils\.py L11](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/block_utils.py#L11) for distance binning and [block\_utils\.py L202](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/block_utils.py#L202) for generating sparse attention masks\. Higher\-level neural network blocks include various embedding layers, such as [blocks\.py L39](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/blocks.py#L39) and [blocks\.py L66](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/blocks.py#L66), as well as [blocks\.py L226](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/blocks.py#L226) for feature recycling and [blocks\.py L277](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/blocks.py#L277)\. Atom\-token communication is handled by [blocks\.py L465](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/blocks.py#L465) and [blocks\.py L514](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/blocks.py#L514) layers, facilitating interaction between atomic and token\-level representations\. Memory\-efficient pairwise embedding is addressed by [chunked\_pairwise\.py L142](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/chunked_pairwise.py#L142), which computes sparse pairwise features\. Specialized encoders like [encoders\.py L36](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/encoders.py#L36) and [encoders\.py L304](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/encoders.py#L304) are responsible for generating and refining initial token and atom representations, integrating diffusion\-related information\. The framework also includes utility layers such as [layer\_utils\.py L27](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/layer_utils.py#L27), [layer\_utils\.py L38](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/model/layers/layer_utils.py#L38), and [layer\_utils\.py L64](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rf3/src/rf3/model/layers/layer_utils.py#L64) for normalization and other common operations\. For further details on the training infrastructure that orchestrates these models, refer to [Model Training Harness](https://codewiki.google/github.com/rosettacommons/foundry#model-training-harness)\.### RFdiffusion3NA: Advanced Input Specification and Inference Workflow

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

The [engine\.py L139](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/engine.py#L139) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/engine.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/engine.py) orchestrates the inference workflow for [README\.md?plain=1 L81](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L81) models\. It manages the loading of model checkpoints, configuration merging, and the dynamic initialization of data transformation pipelines\. The engine processes diverse input specifications, such as file paths, [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20) objects, or [input\_parsing\.py L115](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L115) objects, converting them into a standardized dictionary format\. This canonicalization ensures consistent handling of design problems, which can include complex contig strings and length specifications for protein, DNA, and RNA components\.

 To manage these complex multi\-polymer input specifications, [README\.md?plain=1 L81](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L81) leverages the Pydantic model [input\_parsing\.py L115](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L115) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/inference/input_parsing.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/inference/input_parsing.py)\. This model validates user input, loads [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20) objects from PDB/CIF files, and assigns conditioning annotations like [input\_parsing\.py L152](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L152) or [input\_parsing\.py L160](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L160)\. The [input\_parsing\.py L88](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L88) method within [input\_parsing\.py L115](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L115) constructs the final [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20) by accumulating components \(indexed motifs, unindexed fixed regions, diffused regions\), appending ligands, and applying symmetry transformations\. It also supports partial diffusion, where an input structure is refined rather than designed from scratch\. For compatibility with older formats, [input\_parsing\.py L80](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L80) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/inference/legacy_input_parsing.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/inference/legacy_input_parsing.py) provides a layer to process deprecated input styles\.

 Atom selection and canonicalization are handled by the [parsing\.py L26](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/parsing.py#L26) Pydantic model in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/inference/parsing.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/inference/parsing.py)\. This model parses raw input into structured selection data, generating masks over the [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20) and optionally extracting subsets of [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20) tokens\. It employs functions like [parsing\.py L129](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/parsing.py#L129) and [parsing\.py L102](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/parsing.py#L102) to standardize selection inputs and ensure consistency across different components\.

 Symmetry transformations are managed through utilities in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/inference/symmetry`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/inference/symmetry)\. [symmetry\_utils\.py L41](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/symmetry/symmetry_utils.py#L41) defines symmetry operations, and functions like [atom\_array\.py L15](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/symmetry/atom_array.py#L15) and [atom\_array\.py L152](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/symmetry/atom_array.py#L152) add metadata and transform coordinates\. The system can construct full symmetric [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20) objects using [symmetry\_utils\.py L66](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/symmetry/symmetry_utils.py#L66) and provides mechanisms to check structural integrity\.

 For efficient generation of protein\-DNA\-RNA complexes, [README\.md?plain=1 L81](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L81) supports distributed loading of design data\. The [datasets\.py L31](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/datasets.py#L31) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/inference/datasets.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/inference/datasets.py) loads contig data from JSON, YAML files, or Hydra configurations, handling global arguments and data subsetting\. The function [datasets\.py L177](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/datasets.py#L177) then creates a distributed [train\.py L16](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/mpnn/src/mpnn/train.py#L16) instance, enabling scalable inference across multiple devices\. The logging system utilizes [ddp\.py L58](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/src/foundry/utils/ddp.py#L58) for effective message control in distributed environments\.### RFdiffusion3NA: Comprehensive Data Processing and Conditioning Transforms

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

RFdiffusion3NA utilizes sophisticated data processing and transformation pipelines to prepare multi\-polymer structures for *de novo* design, both during training and inference\. These pipelines are central to how the model interprets and manipulates molecular data, enabling complex conditioning strategies\.

 The core of these transformations is defined within the [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms) directory\. A key function, [pipelines\.py L584](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/pipelines.py#L584) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/pipelines.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/pipelines.py), orchestrates the sequential application of various transformations to [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20) objects\. This modular design allows for flexible configuration based on whether the pipeline is used for training or inference, and supports probabilistic selection of certain transformations\.

 One critical aspect of the data processing is the initialization and typing of molecular data\. For instance, [util\_transforms\.py L87](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/util_transforms.py#L87) from [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/util_transforms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/util_transforms.py) annotates atoms with their molecular type \(protein, RNA, DNA, ligand\), while [util\_transforms\.py L366](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/util_transforms.py#L366) generates token\-level features like residue index and chain IDs\. Additionally, [design\_transforms\.py L399](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/design_transforms.py#L399) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/design_transforms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/design_transforms.py) adds masks for backbone and sidechain atoms\.

 Conditioning for generative models is a core capability, enabling precise control over the design process\. The [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/conditioning_base.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/conditioning_base.py) module defines transformations for managing global conditioning\. This includes [conditioning\_base\.py L213](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/conditioning_base.py#L213) \(for training\) to select specific conditioning strategies and [conditioning\_base\.py L292](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/conditioning_base.py#L292) to apply them\. [conditioning\_base\.py L315](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/conditioning_base.py#L315) dynamically expands "unindexed" motifs—regions of the molecule whose sequences or structures are to be designed—and creates masks for relative position encoding\. Concrete training conditions, such as [training\_conditions\.py L56](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/training_conditions.py#L56) for selecting contiguous token segments and [training\_conditions\.py L176](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/training_conditions.py#L176) for protein\-protein interaction training, are implemented in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/training_conditions.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/training_conditions.py)\.

 The system also supports the generation of various features essential for accurate modeling\. [design\_transforms\.py L117](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/design_transforms.py#L117) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/design_transforms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/design_transforms.py) generates AF3\-like reference features adapted for design, such as reference positions and elements\. [design\_transforms\.py L346](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/design_transforms.py#L346) adds atom\-wise features, including relative accessible surface area \(RASA\) in [input\.md?plain=1 L85](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L85) and annotations for hydrogen bond donors and acceptors\.

 Hydrogen bond information is crucial for molecular interactions\. [hbonds\.py L225](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/hbonds.py#L225) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/hbonds.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/hbonds.py) adds hydrogens and calculates hydrogen bonds, annotating [input\.md?plain=1 L85](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L85) and [input\.md?plain=1 L85](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L85) atoms\. Alternatively, [hbonds\_hbplus\.py L177](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/hbonds_hbplus.py#L177) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/hbonds_hbplus.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/hbonds_hbplus.py) can integrate with the external [README\.md?plain=1 L143](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/README.md?plain=1#L143) program for hydrogen bond identification\.

 For nucleic acids, [na\_geom\.py L103](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/na_geom.py#L103) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/na_geom.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/na_geom.py) generates 2D token\-token matrices representing secondary structure information \(paired/unpaired\) from base\-pair annotations\. This is a crucial component for enabling nucleic acid secondary structure conditioning and base\-pair constraints\.

 Further feature generation includes [rasa\.py L7](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/rasa.py#L7) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/rasa.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/rasa.py) for atom\-wise RASA computation, allowing the model to understand surface accessibility\. For protein\-protein interactions, [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/ppi_transforms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/ppi_transforms.py) adds secondary structure features and interaction hotspots, while [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/symmetry.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/symmetry.py) handles the addition of symmetry\-related features by reconstructing rotation and translation matrices\.

 Data augmentation techniques are also integrated to enhance model robustness\. [design\_transforms\.py L531](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/design_transforms.py#L531) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/design_transforms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/design_transforms.py) perturbs motif coordinates, and [ncaa\_transforms\.py L41](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/ncaa_transforms.py#L41) from [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/ncaa_transforms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/ncaa_transforms.py) performs spatial mirroring, enabling the model to learn from a broader range of structural variations\. The pipeline also includes [virtual\_atoms\.py L139](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/transforms/virtual_atoms.py#L139) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/virtual_atoms.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/virtual_atoms.py) to standardize token sizes, which is important for neural networks requiring fixed input dimensions\.

 Overall, the data processing and transformation pipelines within RFdiffusion3NA are designed to be flexible and comprehensive, supporting a wide array of conditioning strategies and feature generations crucial for the *de novo* design of complex multi\-polymer biomolecules\.### RFdiffusion3NA: Training Framework and Evaluation Metrics for Multi\-Polymers

![Diagram](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

Training and fine\-tuning of [README\.md?plain=1 L81](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L81) are managed by a comprehensive framework that leverages distributed computing and modular component instantiation\. The main entry point for training is the [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/train.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/train.py) script, which uses Hydra for configuration management and [all\.ipynb L84](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L84) for distributed training across multiple devices and nodes\. This setup allows for flexible configuration of datasets, models, optimizers, and learning rate schedulers, facilitating reproducible experiments\.

 The [rfd3\.py L33](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/trainer/rfd3.py#L33) \(defined in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/trainer/rfd3na.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/trainer/rfd3na.py)\), extending the [fabric\.py L56](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/src/foundry/trainers/fabric.py#L56) from [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/trainer/fabric_trainer.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/trainer/fabric_trainer.py)\), orchestrates the training and validation loops\. This trainer is specialized to handle biomolecular structural data, including managing unindexed structural tokens and processing network outputs into [all\.ipynb L20](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L20) objects for subsequent metric computation\. During training, the model is exposed to random "problems" with varying conditioning tasks, which are defined in the [README\.md?plain=1 L171](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/README.md?plain=1#L171) within configuration files\.

 The framework incorporates a suite of specialized loss functions and metrics to guide the training process and evaluate the quality of designed multi\-polymer structures\. The primary loss functions include [losses\.py L7](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/metrics/losses.py#L7) for token sequence prediction and [af3\_losses\.py L416](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rf3/src/rf3/loss/af3_losses.py#L416) for coordinate prediction, which incorporates a smoothed LDDT loss for structural similarity\. These are defined in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/losses.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/losses.py)\.

 For evaluation, a wide array of metrics is calculated\. These metrics, primarily defined in the [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics) directory, cover various aspects of protein\-DNA\-RNA complex design:

 - **Structural Quality**: Metrics for inter\-residue clashes, chain breaks, and backbone integrity are computed using functions like [design\_metrics\.py L19](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/metrics/design_metrics.py#L19) and [design\_metrics\.py L119](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/metrics/design_metrics.py#L119) in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/design_metrics.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/design_metrics.py)\.
- **Sequence Accuracy**: [design\_metrics\.py L422](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/metrics/design_metrics.py#L422) evaluates sequence recovery and generates confusion matrices, comparing predicted sequences against ground truth\.
- **Hydrogen Bond Analysis**: [hbonds\_metrics\.py L324](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/metrics/hbonds_metrics.py#L324) \(in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/hbonds_metrics.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/hbonds_metrics.py) and [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/hbonds_hbplus_metrics.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/hbonds_hbplus_metrics.py)\) assesses the accuracy of predicted hydrogen bonds by comparing donor and acceptor atoms to the ground truth\.
- **Nucleic Acid Secondary Structure**: [nucleic\_ss\_metrics\.py L265](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/nucleic_ss_metrics.py#L265) \(in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/nucleic_ss_metrics.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/nucleic_ss_metrics.py)\) computes F1 scores for base\-pair edges and loop tokens, evaluating the adherence to expected nucleic acid secondary structures\.
- **Ligand Contact**: [rna\_aptamer\_metrics\.py L74](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/rna_aptamer_metrics.py#L74) \(in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/rna_aptamer_metrics.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/rna_aptamer_metrics.py)\) quantifies contacts between designed molecules and specified ligands\.
- **Sidechain Quality**: [sidechain\_metrics\.py L307](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/metrics/sidechain_metrics.py#L307) \(in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/sidechain_metrics.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/metrics/sidechain_metrics.py)\) evaluates the quality of protein sidechains by checking for unintended bonds and clashes, ensuring chemically plausible designs\.

 These metrics are integrated into the validation step, where an [engine\.py L13](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/engine.py#L13) is constructed from model outputs, and metrics are computed and logged\. Callbacks, such as [dump\_validation\_structures\.py L19](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/trainer/dump_validation_structures.py#L19) \(in [`models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/trainer/dump_validation_structures.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/trainer/dump_validation_structures.py)\), further enhance the training process by saving predicted structures and trajectories to disk for detailed post\-analysis\. Logging of training progress and hyperparameters is handled by [ddp\.py L58](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/src/foundry/utils/ddp.py#L58) and integrated loggers like Weights & Biases or a CSV logger\.### RFdiffusion3NA: Practical Design Tutorials and Examples

| Tutorial | Design Task | Key Configuration Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enzyme Design | Designing cysteine hydrolases around a ligand, focusing on active site geometry\. | ligand, unindex, select\_fixed\_atoms \(side chain/backbone atoms\), length, ori\_token, select\_buried, select\_exposed, select\_unfixed\_sequence |
| Nucleic Acid Binder Design | Designing a DNA\-protein complex, including nucleic acid segments and sequence modification\. | contig \(mixed protein/DNA\), length, unindex \(unindexed motif for backbone fix\), select\_fixed\_atoms \(DNA strands and motif backbone\), ori\_token, is\_non\_loopy, select\_hbond\_acceptor, select\_hbond\_donor, select\_unfixed\_sequence \(motif side chains\) |
| Protein\-Protein Interface Design | Designing a binder for a human insulin receptor\. | contig \(protein\-only\), length, select\_hotspots \(for interface definition\), infer\_ori\_strategy \(hotspots\), is\_non\_loopy, select\_fixed\_atoms \(optional flexibility\) |
| RNA / DNA Design | General RNA/DNA and hybrid RNA\-protein design with various structural constraints\. | contig \(R/D suffixes\), ss\_dbn, ss\_dbn\_dict, paired\_region\_list, paired\_position\_list, ligand \(for aptamer design\), select\_buried, select\_hbond\_acceptor, select\_hbond\_donor, unindex, select\_fixed\_atoms |

RFdiffusion3NA provides practical tutorials and examples for designing complex multi\-polymer structures, including proteins, DNA, and RNA, as detailed in [`models/rfd3na/docs`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/docs)\. These tutorials guide users through input configuration, execution, and output analysis for a range of design tasks\.

 For advanced features, [`models/rfd3na/docs/examples`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/docs/examples) contains documentation on how to define multi\-polymer contigs \(RNA and DNA segments\), implement secondary structure conditioning using dot\-bracket notation, and apply base\-pair constraints\. It also covers ligand\-conditioned aptamer design, where options like [input\_parsing\.py L142](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L142), [input\_parsing\.py L170](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L170), [input\_parsing\.py L174](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L174), and [input\_parsing\.py L175](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L175) are used to guide aptamer binding to small molecules\. Hybrid RNA\-protein designs can fix or unindex specific structural elements using [input\_parsing\.py L135](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L135) and [input\_parsing\.py L152](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L152)\.

 The [`models/rfd3na/docs/tutorials`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/docs/tutorials) directory offers step\-by\-step guides for various design applications:

 - **Enzyme Design:** The [`models/rfd3na/docs/tutorials/enzyme_design_tutorial.md`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/docs/tutorials/enzyme_design_tutorial.md) tutorial demonstrates how to design cysteine hydrolases by configuring JSON input with parameters such as [input\_parsing\.py L142](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L142) for specifying the binding molecule, [input\_parsing\.py L135](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L135) to allow flexibility in residue positions, and [input\_parsing\.py L152](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L152) to preserve catalytic residues or specific backbone elements\. It also utilizes [input\_parsing\.py L170](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L170) and [input\_parsing\.py L172](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L172) for controlling solvent accessibility and [input\_parsing\.py L160](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L160) for sequence modifications while maintaining backbone structure\.
- **Nucleic Acid Binder Design:** The [`models/rfd3na/docs/tutorials/na_binder_tutorial.md`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/docs/tutorials/na_binder_tutorial.md) tutorial focuses on designing protein\-nucleic acid complexes\. It uses a [input\_parsing\.py L134](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L134) string to define fixed regions, chain breaks \([input\.md?plain=1 L39](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L39)\), and length ranges for designed segments\. Other parameters like [input\_parsing\.py L135](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L135) allow for flexible motif placement, while [input\_parsing\.py L174](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L174) and [input\_parsing\.py L175](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L175) can be used for hydrogen bond conditioning\.
- **Protein\-Protein Interface \(PPI\) Design:** The [`models/rfd3na/docs/tutorials/ppi_design_tutorial.md`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/docs/tutorials/ppi_design_tutorial.md) tutorial guides users through designing binders for specific protein targets, such as the human insulin receptor\. It employs [input\_parsing\.py L176](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/inference/input_parsing.py#L176) to define target interaction sites and [inference\.py L399](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/utils/inference.py#L399) to orient the design process around these sites\. The [input\.md?plain=1 L70](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L70) option helps to reduce undesirable loop formations\.

 These tutorials detail the execution of [README\.md?plain=1 L1](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L1) commands and the analysis of output files, typically in [README\.md?plain=1 L620](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rf3/README.md?plain=1#L620) and [README\.md?plain=1 L67](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/README.md?plain=1#L67) formats, which contain the designed structures and associated metadata\. For a complete understanding of input specifications, refer to [RFdiffusion3NA: Advanced Input Specification and Inference Workflow](https://codewiki.google/github.com/rosettacommons/foundry#de-novo-multi-polymer-interaction-design-rfdiffusion3na-rfdiffusion3na-advanced-input-specification-and-inference-workflow) and the [`models/rfd3na/docs/input.md`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/docs/input.md) documentation, which describes the [input\.md?plain=1 L112](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L112) object and its selection mini\-language\. Additionally, the [`models/rfd3na/docs/intro_inference_calculations.md`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/docs/intro_inference_calculations.md) file clarifies inference configuration, execution, and output conventions\. A utility script, [`models/rfd3na/docs/get_na_input.sh`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/docs/get_na_input.sh), is also provided to assist in preparing PDB files of various nucleic acid types for design tasks\.### RFdiffusion3NA: Testing and Debugging Infrastructure

| Category | Description | File Path\(s\) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Core Functionality Tests | Tests related to basic model imports, inference pipelines, training pipelines, and dataset instantiation\. | test\_aa\_design\.py |
| Conditioning Logic Tests | Validation of various conditioning mechanisms, including RASA and pLDDT conditioning\. | test\_conditioning\.py |
| Feature and Glycine Tests | Verification of glycine\-specific features and is\_x flags in the atom array\. | test\_glycines\.py |
| Legacy Pipeline Equivalence | Ensures backward compatibility and equivalence of new pipeline implementations with legacy versions\. | test\_legacy\_pipeline\_equivalence\.py |
| Metrics and Output Validation | Checks the generation and correctness of various output metrics after pipeline execution\. | test\_metrics\.py |
| Partial Diffusion & Unindexing | Tests for scenarios involving partial diffusion and the unindexing of motifs within the pipeline\. | test\_partial\_diffusion\.py, test\_unindexing\.py, test\_tokenization\.py |
| Symmetry\-related Functionalities | Comprehensive testing of symmetry checks, contig handling, and frame generation for symmetric assemblies\. | test\_rfd3na\_symmetry\_atom\_array\.py, test\_rfd3na\_symmetry\_checks\.py, test\_rfd3na\_symmetry\_contigs\.py, test\_rfd3na\_symmetry\_frames\.py, test\_symmetry\.py |
| Utility Functions | Unit tests for various helper utilities including configuration parsing, I/O operations, flattening dictionaries, and dot\-bracket parsing\. | test\_rfd3na\_cfg\_utils\.py, test\_rfd3na\_conditioning\_utils\.py, test\_rfd3na\_io\.py, test\_rfd3na\_metrics\_utils\.py, test\_rfd3na\_na\_geom\_utils\.py |
| Subgraph Sampling & Selections | Validation of subgraph sampling mechanisms and input selection logic within the atom array\. | test\_subgraph\_sampling\.py, test\_selections\.py |
| Regression Tests | Ensures consistent behavior of the atom14 base pipeline against stored regression data\. | transforms/test\_pipeline\_regression\.py |
| Debugging Tools | Tools and utilities used for debugging pipelines and model outputs\. | rfd3na/testing/debug\.py, rfd3na/testing/debug\_utils\.py, rfd3na/testing/testing\_utils\.py |

The [README\.md?plain=1 L81](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/README.md?plain=1#L81) codebase incorporates a comprehensive testing and debugging infrastructure to ensure the reliability and correctness of its multi\-polymer design capabilities\. This infrastructure supports unit and regression testing for core functionalities, conditioning logic, metrics, tokenization, and symmetry operations, and provides utilities for debugging model forward passes and structural biology outputs\.

 The testing suite, primarily located in [`models/rfd3na/tests`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests), uses [pyproject\.toml L295](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/pyproject.toml#L295) to orchestrate tests\. A configuration file, [`models/rfd3na/tests/conftest.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/conftest.py), manages which tests are collected, allowing CPU\-portable tests to run in continuous integration while excluding cluster\-coupled tests that rely on specific large datasets or configurations\.

 Key tests validate the core [pyproject\.toml L54](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/pyproject.toml#L54) library imports, configuration parsing, and the execution of both inference and training pipelines\. This includes verifying successful instantiation of datasets and samplers\. Conditioning logic, such as the generation and presence of [input\.md?plain=1 L134](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/docs/input.md?plain=1#L134) and [all\.ipynb L231](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/examples/all.ipynb#L231) features in both training and inference modes, is rigorously checked in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_conditioning.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_conditioning.py)\. Glycine handling and its impact on feature computation are also specifically tested in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_glycines.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_glycines.py) to ensure correctness\. The accuracy of output metrics for the backbone design process is verified in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_metrics.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_metrics.py), as is the correct behavior of partial diffusion mechanisms in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_partial_diffusion.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_partial_diffusion.py)\. Tokenization and unindexing functionalities are thoroughly tested in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_tokenization.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_tokenization.py) and [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_unindexing.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_unindexing.py) to confirm that original atom arrays can be recovered and that [rfd3\.py L399](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/trainer/rfd3.py#L399) is correctly computed after motif atoms are unindexed\.

 Utility functions are also subject to testing\. This includes configuration utilities for classifier\-free guidance in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_cfg_utils.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_cfg_utils.py), conditioning utilities for building training\-time motif masks in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_conditioning_utils.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_conditioning_utils.py), and I/O utilities for ID extraction and [engine\.py L13](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3/src/rfd3/engine.py#L13) construction in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_io.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_io.py)\. Nucleic acid geometry utilities, such as [na\_geom\_utils\.py L1573](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/src/rfd3na/transforms/na_geom_utils.py#L1573) for converting dot\-bracket strings into base pairs in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_na_geom_utils.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_na_geom_utils.py), are validated, along with selection utilities for canonicalizing component selections and generating atom masks in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_selections.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_selections.py)\. Subgraph sampling in [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_subgraph_sampling.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_subgraph_sampling.py) is tested for its ability to extract portions of an atom array\.

 Symmetry\-related functionalities are extensively tested in files such as [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_symmetry_atom_array.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_symmetry_atom_array.py), [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_symmetry_checks.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_rfd3na_symmetry_checks.py), and [`models/rfd3na/tests/test_symmetry.py`](https://github.com/rosettacommons/foundry/blob/551a90103a51d0bff27e269fe454fdba4aefb274/models/rfd3na/tests/test_symmetry.py)\. These cover helper functions for symmetric assembly building, reannotation of chain IDs, application of symmetry transformations, and checks for valid multiplicity and structural symmetry\.
